== chapter 110 ==
፻፲ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ትንሣኤሁ ።

- i: And as Solomon his son prophesied, he said: 'The scales of injustice are hated before God.' And as Jeremiah the prophet prophesied, he said: 'Concerning Judas, my wage is ready for me: thirty (pieces) of silver.'
